// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The permitted question: is THIS one address being refused. Keyed by an HMAC
// the caller computed, so the address itself never reaches the query and is
// never stored. findUnique, never findMany: the difference between answering a
// support call and printing a register of locked-out families.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function refusalFor(addressHmac: string) {
  return db.mailSuppression.findUnique({
    where: { addressHmac },
    select: { state: true, lastSeenAt: true },
  });
}
